title: In This World It Only Rains On Sad People
description: Sora has carried an umbrella for 212 days, and she thinks she is the only one. Who would you share an umbrella with? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Sora: 16-year-old Japanese girl, shoulder-length black hair with a small white hair clip, navy blazer school uniform with a gray pleated skirt and red ribbon tie, black knee socks, brown loafers, holds a plain dark blue umbrella, no hat
characters.Mei: 16-year-old Japanese girl, short brown bob haircut, round face, beige knitted cardigan over a white blouse and the same gray pleated school skirt, white socks, brown loafers, holds a plain red umbrella with two bent spokes, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, when you're sad, it rains only on you. Everyone else stays dry. Sora has walked to school under her own little rain cloud for 212 days.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Quiet residential street in a small Japanese town on a sunny morning, two students walk by dry and squinting in the sun. [4-7s] Medium shot: Sora walks along the same sunny street under a dark blue umbrella while a small gray rain cloud pours only on her. [7-10s] Close-up of Sora's face under the umbrella, raindrops running off the edge, eyes down.

scenes.say: People read it like weather. A drizzle means a bad test. A storm means heartbreak. Sora's storm started the day she and her best friend Mei stopped talking.
scenes.video: [0-4s] School corridor by the windows, a boy with a faint drizzle over his head frowns at a folded test paper held face down. [4-7s] Faded flashback in an empty classroom after school: Sora and Mei turn away from each other, arms crossed. [7-10s] Back on the street outside the school gate, Sora's small rain cloud thickens and pours harder on her umbrella.

scenes.say: So Sora avoids the river, because that's the way Mei walks home. But one windy afternoon her umbrella snaps, and the only repair shop is across the old river bridge.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On a windy sidewalk beside a rice field, Sora's dark blue umbrella flips inside out and two spokes snap. [4-7s] Sora stands soaked at the foot of an old wooden river bridge under her own rain cloud, hesitating. [7-10s] Wide shot of the old wooden river bridge on a sunny afternoon, Sora stepping onto it alone, the rain following her.

scenes.say: Halfway across, someone is standing at the rail, soaked, holding a broken red umbrella. It's Mei. Above her head, a gray cloud just like Sora's. It started the same day.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Middle of the old wooden river bridge: Mei stands at the railing, soaked, holding a red umbrella with two bent spokes. [4-7s] Medium shot of Mei under her own small gray rain cloud, turning toward the camera in surprise. [7-10s] Close-up of Sora on the bridge, eyes widening, rain dripping from her bangs.

scenes.say: Neither of them says sorry. Mei just lifts her bent umbrella a little higher, and Sora steps under it. Two clouds, one broken umbrella. And the rain gets lighter.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the old wooden river bridge, Mei slowly raises her bent red umbrella. [4-7s] Sora steps under it beside Mei, shoulders touching, both looking ahead and not at each other. [7-10s] Low angle from the bridge deck: the two small gray clouds above them drift together and the rain thins to a light drizzle.

scenes.say: By the end of the bridge the sun is out, and Mei laughs at how ridiculous they look. In this world, it rains only on you. Unless you share.
scenes.video: [0-4s] End of the old wooden river bridge in warm afternoon sun, Sora and Mei walk out dripping under the bent red umbrella, no clouds above them. [4-7s] Close-up: Mei bursts out laughing; Sora tries not to, then laughs too. [7-10s] Wide shot from behind as the two girls walk along the sunny riverside path, the broken umbrella still open over both of them.
